name: Housing Summertime (and the End of the World)
source:
A post-apocalyptic story inspired by the horrors of helplessness and the fruitless endeavour to exist and love in a dead world.

Follow "university researchers" Kobiko Megane and Housui Sagawa, trying to find themselves and each other in a destroyed world before it's all gone.

Made for the 2026 Spooktober Visual Nover Jam.

itch.io: https://kevinmonitor.itch.io/housing-summertime
translation:
一部后启示录题材的故事，灵感源自深切的无力感所带来的战栗，以及在垂死世界中徒劳追寻生存与爱恋的挣扎。

跟随两名“大学研究员”目金小美子（Kobiko Megane）与佐川丰水（Housui Sagawa）的脚步，看他们在万物彻底湮灭之前，如何在满目疮痍的末世中找寻自我与彼此。

本作系为2026年Spooktober视觉小说开发大赛创作。
